description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android Activity ('AppSelectionActivity') and associated ViewModel ('AppSelectionViewModel') for a user interface that displays a searchable, selectable list of installed applications. The activity enables users to select apps to monitor, persisting the selection. It includes a RecyclerView adapter ('AppsAdapter') for displaying app rows with icons, labels, and checkboxes.

classes.name: AppSelectionActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for selecting installed apps with search and save functionalities.

classes.name: AppSelectionViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing app list, search filtering, selection state, and persistence.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying app list with checkboxes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, observers, and event listeners.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts collecting UI state updates from the ViewModel.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cancels ongoing collection jobs during activity stop.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine scope and resources.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Handles the save action by persisting selected apps and providing feedback.

methods.name: loadInstalledApps
methods.description: Loads and returns a list of installed user applications.

methods.name: onSearchQueryChanged
methods.description: Updates the visible app list based on the search query.

methods.name: onTogglePackage
methods.description: Updates the selected packages when user toggles an app checkbox.

methods.name: persistSelection
methods.description: Saves current selection to preferences repository.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the RecyclerView adapter with a new app list efficiently.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds app data to view holder components.
